title: RingCentral adds Shopify, Calendly, and WhatsApp to AI Receptionist
summary: RingCentral expanded its AI Receptionist (AIR) product with new integrations to Shopify, Calendly, and WhatsApp, enabling the AI to handle customer order inquiries through Shopify, schedule appointments via Calendly, and communicate via WhatsApp - moving beyond basic call answering into routine customer service tasks.
problem_solved: Automates routine customer service tasks like order inquiries and appointment scheduling without human intervention
why_valuable: Reduces manual workload for businesses while providing customers with instant, 24/7 support for common inquiries
